bull.b: Digitization via SurfOS has driven recurring operational cost savings and reliability gains (fewer irregular ops, better crew scheduling and dispatch). bull.t: Strategic BETA partnership and electric aviation pipeline

bear.b: Negative equity and meaningful secured debt create structural financial fragility: limited capacity to absorb further losses, higher refinancing risk, and constrained ability to fund growth without dilutive or restrictive financing. This reduces strategic optionality over the medium term.

Large, persistent negative operating and free cash flow indicate the business requires ongoing external funding to maintain operations and execute initiatives. bear.t: Execution and timing risk on SurfOS monetization & electrification
bear.b: Key profitability and capex benefits depend on converting SurfOS pipeline and achieving electric aircraft certification.
